name: ietf-meeting-vcons
description: vCons (syntax 0.5.0, draft-ietf-vcon-vcon-core-05) for IETF group sessions: numbered meetings 66-126, 61 consecutive meetings, plus the VCON working group's 2026 interim sessions, one file per group per meeting. Session times come from the official meeting schedule and each file records how its chairs were determined; recordings are linked by URL, not stored, and transcripts are carried as analysis. Files name session chairs with the email addresses published for their role, and chair records also name past role holders. No attendee lists are included, though linked bluesheets and transcripts name participants.
